SPE10 model 2 — NVRS-CUDA

Clement Etienam · Oleg Ovcharenko · Nick Luiken · Issam Said

The Tenth SPE Comparative Solution Project, model 2: the standard test of a solver's tolerance of heterogeneity, built as an upscaling exercise that most of the original participants could not run on the fine grid. This page reports one run of it on NVRS-CUDA — the rock, the flood, the wells, the recovery and the material balance.
